For example if I have $500 in my checking account on Monday July 1st and will get a salary check direct deposited on Friday July 5th of $200 and then will have a cell phone bill of $150 taken out on Saturday July 6th then my projected account balance for July 6th will be $550.

The YNAB tool is great for budgeting and has truly changed our financial situation, but having to fight the app all the time to learn new things and tap more times to do the same things is really making it difficult to even want to open the app to manage our budget.

solid foundation for a budget app, accounting for each dollar every month. but it struggles with credit cards, and I wish there were more analytics like for spending trends, maybe visuals of income vs spending, maybe a breakdown of budgeted funds. the features are a little sparse as is, for the over $100 price tag. I have a weekly auto transfer to savings and had literally no idea how this app wanted me to categorize it.

However, I am giving 4 stars instead of 3 because the app functionality *has* increased for those who do most of their YNAB on their phones.

YNAB has changed the way I manage money and the Android app gets better with every release.

If you want to focus on budgeting and want transactions to automatically import, YNAB is the app for you. I have tried probably every budgeting app available and YNAB was the only one that let me fully manage and see my budget while syncing with every other institution. Sometimes transaction importing has issues, but YNAB is still the best.

YNAB allows me to pinpoint all aspects of my budget. even months or years later, I have an account of my spending. it has helped keep our family floating during lean times and saving during fat times. I highly recommend it.

This app has made such a difference in my budgeting. In the 6 months I've been using it, I've paid off a credit card, paid vet expenses without debt, been able to finance a car because I knew exactly what kind of payments I could afford, and today I was able to catch that I had 2 paid accounts for an app (which had gone unnoticed since 2022!!). I really appreciate that no feature updates have removed or broken functionality I relied on, which is so common with apps!
